fuel.sourceTable: FUEL LATERAL MOMENT PER TANK TABLE
fuel.sourcePage: AHM 560 Appendix I s.75 (LOAD AND TRIM SHEET page 3)
fuel.reason: The only copy of that page we hold is a 174 ppi scan in which 6/8 and 0/3 are not separable at the printed one-decimal precision; see AHM560_ERRATA.md Kayit 10. No value is guessed.

verification.note: The payload y-arms, the limit and the operational margin are read cleanly from the approved plate. The fuel half of the same table is not transcribed, so a complete lateral imbalance cannot yet be computed and checkLateralImbalance() must stay NOT_AVAILABLE / provisional.

notes: Printed caution: "The lateral imbalance of the aircraft due to asymmetric loading of cargo & fuel must not exceed a lateral moment of +/- 34 000 kg.m".
Per payload row: lateral imbalance (kg.m) = (weight LEFT - weight RIGHT) x y-arm.
Fuel rows are entered directly as lateral moment (kg.m) per tank pair, LEFT minus RIGHT.

The operational margin is a fixed 11 554 kg.m added on top of the total. Printed rule: "SIGN OF OPERATIONAL MARGIN IS IDENTICAL TO SIGN OF TOTAL IMBALANCE WITHOUT OPERATIONAL MARGIN" - so the margin always makes the result worse, never better.
The plate titles this table FOR SIDE-BY-SIDE PALLETS ONLY: single-row and bridge positions are centred and contribute no lateral moment.
The plate's footnote (1) points at page 3 for the fuel lateral moments.
